verdict.rationale: Community reports describe a first-party open-source Extend UI kit, with a public repo whose package.json and components users inspected, so some Extend source is readable. The core document-processing platform is not shown to be open source, and no first-party docs name a license. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core platform/API source, a named open license, first-party documentation of the repository and licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Extend's open-source UI kit was exactly what they needed for DOCX and XLSX previews in their app
One user also found Next.js dependencies in the repo's package.json and components.
